title: MCP Auth Required
description: Returned when a tool requires MIKROS MCP authentication.

loginUrl.description: Browser URL to connect an existing MIKROS account to MCP.

signupUrl.description: Browser URL to create a new MIKROS account for MCP.

pendingTool.description: Original tool to retry after auth.

pendingArguments.description: Original arguments to retry after auth.

examples.message: Open this authorization URL to grant the MIKROS MCP server access.
instructions: 1. Open the authorization URL in your browser
2. Verify your MIKROS account to grant MCP access
3. Wait for the MCP authorization success page
4. Return here and retry your original request
